translations.text: Confession. I confess to God the almighty Father, and to all his holy relics, and to you, man of God, all my sins that I have thought
and spoken and done since I first began to commit sin. I also confess whatever I have done that was against my Christianity,
and against my faith, and against my confession, and against my teacher, and against my office,
and against my rule. I confess envy and ill will, hatred and slander, swearing and lying,
sinful lusts, and my neglected hours, pride, and sloth in God's service, fornications, manslaughters, gluttony and drunkenness,
and also that I took food and drink at improper times. I also confess that I spilled consecrated food and drink, and did not keep the duties of my office as I should have,
and consumed more than I should have. I confess to you that I did not honour and love my father and mother as I should have.
And also that I did not honour and love my brothers and my sisters and my other kin and my friends as I should have.
This I confess plainly: that I did not honour and love poor people and other strangers as I should have.
I confess that I did not teach my disciples and my godchildren as I should have. The holy Sunday and the holy Mass
I did not keep holy and honour as I should have. I did not receive our Lord's body and his blood with such fear and with such love as I should have.
I did not visit the sick and give them what they needed as I should have. I did not comfort the sorrowful and the unhappy as I should have. I did not pay my tithe as rightly as I should have.
I did not receive guests as I should have. I also confess that I stirred up strife among those whom I should not have troubled, and did not reconcile those whom I should have reconciled.
I confess wrongful sights, wrongful hearings, and wrongful thoughts, wrongful words, wrongful deeds, wrongful sitting,
wrongful standing, wrongful walking, wrongful lying down, wrongful kissing, wrongful embracing, wrongful touching.
I listened to heathen things and unclean [?] songs/plays. I believed what I should not have believed. I stole; I received stolen goods; I gave without permission; I received without permission.
I swore false oaths on relics. I had anger and strife in me, and discord and envy. I sinned in false witness
and in cursing. I did not keep and fulfil my hours and my prayer as I should have. I read wrongly, sang wrongly, was disobedient.
I spoke more and was silent more than I should have, and defiled myself with evil words and with evil deeds and with evil thoughts, with evil lusts, more than I should have.
I confess that I thought wrongful things in church, and distracted others from the holy reading. I did not honour and love bishops and priests as I should have.
I confess all of this that I have now named and cannot name, whether I did it knowingly or unknowingly, whether in belief or in unbelief.
whatever of this I did that was against God's will, whether waking or sleeping, whether by day or by night, or at whatever time it was.
So I commit all of it to the protection of almighty God and to his mercy. And now I make my confession of all of it sincerely
to God the almighty Father, and to all his saints, and to you, man of God. I am willing to make amends according to God's will. And I ask you for your prayers,
that you will be my intercessor with God, so that I may end my life and my faith in God's favour.
